entries.toelichting: Place where Saul mustered (1Sam 15:4). English convention: Telaim. 'Lambs'.
1Sam 7:9; Isa 40:11; 65:25. Hyphenated to mark suckling-lamb distinct from H3532 keves yearling-lamb.
Negev town and gatekeeper-ancestor (Josh 15:24; Ezr 10:24). English convention: Telem.
Levitical gatekeeper-family-head (1Chr 9:17; Ezr 2:42; Neh 7:45; 11:19; 12:25). English convention: Talmon.
Qal: perceive-by-tongue, also discern (1Sam 14:24,29,43; 2Sam 3:35; 19:35; Job 12:11; 34:3; Ps 34:8; Prov 31:18; Jonah 3:7). Hyphenated to mark dual physical-and-mental aspect.

Physical-flavor and mental-discernment (Ex 16:31; Num 11:8; 1Sam 21:13; 25:33; Job 6:6,30; 12:20; Ps 34:1 (title); 119:66; Prov 11:22; 26:16; Jonah 3:7). Hyphenated to preserve dual aspect of physical-flavor and discernment-judgment.
Qal/Pi: outspread, raise-up-children (Lam 2:22; Isa 48:13). Hyphenated to mark dual aspect.
Measure of palm-width (Ex 25:25; 37:12; 1Kgs 7:26; 2Chr 4:5; Eze 40:5,43; 43:13). Standard concordant.
Qal: plaster-with-falsehood (Job 13:4; 14:17; Ps 119:69). Hyphenated to mark slanderous-coating.
Daughter of Solomon (1Kgs 4:11). English convention: Taphath.
Animal carcass torn by beasts (Gen 31:39; Ex 22:13,31; Lev 7:24; 17:15; 22:8; Eze 4:14; 44:31; Nah 2:12). Hyphenated to mark prohibited-by-tearing distinct from H2964 teref captured-prey.
Multiple persons (2Kgs 25:23; Jer 35:3; 40:8; Eze 8:11; 11:1). English convention: Jaazaniah. 'YHWH-hears'.
Multiple persons including the judge (Num 32:41; Deut 3:14; Josh 13:30; Judg 10:3,5; 1Kgs 4:13; 1Chr 2:22,23; 20:5; Esth 2:5). English convention: Jair.
Gentilic of Jair (2Sam 20:26). English convention: Jairite.
Hi: take-it-upon-oneself, deign (Gen 18:27,31; Deut 1:5; Josh 7:7; 17:12; Judg 1:27,35; 17:11; 19:6; 1Sam 12:22; 17:39; 2Sam 7:29; 2Kgs 5:23; 6:3; 1Chr 17:27; Job 6:9,28; Hos 5:11). Hyphenated.
Ni/Pi: despair (1Sam 27:1; Job 6:26; Ecc 2:20; Isa 57:10; Jer 2:25; 18:12). Hyphenated.
Pre-Davidic name of Jerusalem (Josh 18:28; Judg 19:10,11; 1Chr 11:4,5). English convention: Jebus.
Two Canaanite kings of Hazor (Josh 11:1; Judg 4:2,7,17,23,24; Ps 83:9). English convention: Jabin.
Cain's descendant, father of tent-dwelling cattle-keepers (Gen 4:20). English convention: Jabal.
Manassite border-town (Josh 17:11; Judg 1:27; 2Kgs 9:27). English convention: Ibleam.
Border-town of Judah and Naphtali (Josh 15:11; 19:33). English convention: Jabneel. 'Mighty-One-causes-to-build'.
Tributary of Jordan (Gen 32:22; Num 21:24; Deut 2:37; 3:16; Josh 12:2; Judg 11:13,22). English convention: Jabbok.
Father of Zechariah (Isa 8:2). English convention: Jeberechiah. 'YHWH-blesses'.
Num 6:3; Job 13:25; Isa 56:3; Eze 17:24; 21:3; 37:2,4; Nah 1:10. Standard concordant.
Jabesh-Gilead and father of Shallum (Judg 21:8-14; 1Sam 11:1-10; 31:11-13; 2Sam 2:4-5; 21:12; 1Chr 10:11,12; 2Kgs 15:10,13,14). English convention: Jabesh.
Spy from Issachar, also David's mighty man (Num 13:7; 2Sam 23:36; 1Chr 3:22). English convention: Igal.
Gadite city (Num 32:35; Judg 8:11). English convention: Jogbehah.
Father of Hanan (Jer 35:4). English convention: Igdaliah. 'YHWH-makes-great'.
Negev town of Judah (Josh 15:21). English convention: Jagur.
Toil and its earned-product (Gen 31:42; Deut 28:33; Job 10:3; 39:11,16; Ps 78:46; 109:11; 128:2; Prov 5:10; Isa 45:14; 55:2; Jer 3:24; 20:5; Eze 23:29; Hos 12:8; Hag 1:11). Hyphenated.
Father of Bukki (Num 34:22). English convention: Jogli.
Qal: dread (Deut 9:19; 28:60; Job 3:25; 9:28; Ps 119:39; Hos 10:5). Hyphenated.
Aramaic name Laban gave the heap (Gen 31:47). Hyphenated. 'Heap-of-witness'.

Hand, also figuratively for power, control, side, monument, axle (one of the most frequent nouns in Hebrew, ~1,617 occurrences across all OT books — particularly central to covenant 'mighty-hand-and-outstretched-arm' formula in Ex/Deut, prophetic 'hand of YHWH', wisdom 'hand of the diligent' in Prov, etc). Standard concordant 'hand'.
Pi: cast lots (Joel 3:3; Obad 1:11; Nah 3:10). Hyphenated.
Covenant-signer and high-priest (Neh 10:21; 12:11,22). English convention: Jaddua.
Levitical chief musician (1Chr 9:16; 16:38,41,42; 25:1,3,6; 2Chr 5:12; 29:14; 35:15; Neh 11:17; Ps 39 title; 62 title; 77 title). English convention: Jeduthun.
Deut 33:12; Ps 45:1; 60:5; 84:1; 108:6; 127:2; Isa 5:1; Jer 11:15. Standard concordant.
Mother of Josiah (2Kgs 22:1). English convention: Jedidah. 'Beloved'.
YHWH's name for Solomon (2Sam 12:25). English convention: Jedidiah. 'Beloved-of-YHWH'.
Son of Nahor (Gen 22:22). English convention: Jidlaph.

Qal/Ni/Pi/Pu/Hi/Hithp: know-experientially, perceive, recognize, also euphemism for sexual-knowing (Gen 2:9,17; 3:5,7,22; 4:1,17,25; 8:11; 9:24; 12:11; 15:8,13; 18:19,21; 19:5,8,33,35; 20:6,7; 21:26; 22:12; 24:14,16,21; 25:27; 27:2; 28:16; 29:5; 30:26,29; 31:6,32; 33:13; 38:9,16,26; 39:6,8; 41:21,31,39; 42:23,33,34; 43:7,22; 44:15,27; 45:1; 47:6; 48:19; 50:20+ extensive across all OT). 'Know' is the standard concordant rendering covering experiential, intellectual, sexual, and covenantal knowing. Standard concordant.
Multiple priests and post-exilic returnees (1Chr 9:10; 24:7; Ezr 2:36; Neh 3:10; 7:39; 11:10; 12:6,7,19,21; Zech 6:10,14). English convention: Jedaiah. 'YHWH-knows'.

Spiritist, consulter-of-knowledge (Lev 19:31; 20:6,27; Deut 18:11; 1Sam 28:3,9; 2Kgs 21:6; 23:24; 2Chr 33:6; Isa 8:19; 19:3). Hyphenated to mark forbidden-knowing-spirit distinct from H178 ov necromancer.
Aramaic; extensive use in Ezra-Daniel. Hyphenated.
Wife in Judah's genealogy (1Chr 4:18). English convention: Jehudijah. 'The-Jewess'.
Multiple kings of Israel and Judah (2Kgs 10:35; 13:1,4,7,8,9,10,22,25; 14:1,8,17; 23:30,31,34; 1Chr 3:15; 2Chr 21:17; 25:17,23,25; 36:1,2,4). English convention: Jehoahaz. 'YHWH-has-grasped'.
Long-form of Joash, kings of Israel and Judah (2Kgs 11:21; 12:1-21; 13:10,25; 14:8,9,11,13,15,16,17,23). English convention: Jehoash. 'YHWH-has-given'.

Patriarch and his tribe and the southern kingdom (Gen 29:35; 35:23; 37:26; 38:1-26; 43:3-44:34; 46:12,28; 49:8-10; Ex 1:2; 31:2; 35:30; 38:22; Num 1:7,26,27; 2:3,9; 7:12,17; 10:14; 13:6; 26:19-22; 34:19+ extensive — entire books of Kings, Chronicles, much of Prophets and Psalms). English convention: Judah. 'Praise'.

Member of tribe-or-kingdom of Judah, later 'Jew' (2Kgs 16:6; 18:26,28; 25:25; 1Chr 4:18; Neh 1:2; 2:16; 3:33,34; 4:1,6; 5:1,8,17; 6:6; 13:23; Esth 2:5; 3:4-13; 4:3,7,13,14,16,17; 5:13; 6:10,13; 8:1,3,5,7,8,9,11,13,16,17; 9:1-31; 10:3; Jer 32:12; 34:9; 38:19; 40:11,12; 41:3; 43:9; 44:1; 52:28,30; Zech 8:23). English convention: Judean (preserves geographic-tribal kernel; 'Jew' is later religious-ethnic specialization).

The Tetragrammaton, the personal name of the Mighty-One revealed at the burning bush (Ex 3:14-15) and central to all OT theology. ~6,828 occurrences across the entire Hebrew Bible. Concordantly transliterated as the four consonants 'YHWH' to preserve the source-text without imposing a reconstructed vocalization (Yahweh/Jehovah are reconstructions; Adonai is reading-tradition). KJV 'LORD' is a translation-by-substitution (avoiding the divine name) and rejected for concordant work; the source has the actual proper-name and the rendering should preserve it.

Same Tetragrammaton, vocalized in the Masoretic text with Elohim-vowels rather than Adonai-vowels because preceded by Adonai (H136) — to avoid 'Adonai-Adonai' read-aloud. Orthographically identical consonants as H3068; the difference is purely Masoretic-pointing for liturgical reading. Concordant rendering: 'YHWH' (same as H3068, since the source-consonants are identical). Used 305 times mostly in 'Adonai YHWH' / 'YHWH-Mighty-One' formulas in Eze.
Multiple persons (2Kgs 25:23; 1Chr 26:3; 2Chr 17:15; 23:1; 28:12; Ezr 10:6,28; Neh 6:18; 12:13,42). English convention: Jehohanan. 'YHWH-has-favored'.
King of Judah (2Kgs 24:6,8,12,15; 25:27; 2Chr 36:8,9; Esth 2:6; Jer 52:31; Eze 1:2). English convention: Jehoiachin. 'YHWH-establishes'.
Priestly division-head (1Chr 9:10; 24:7; Neh 11:10; 12:6,19). English convention: Jehoiarib. 'YHWH-contends'.
Rechabite-founder and David's nephew (2Sam 13:5; 2Kgs 10:15,23; Jer 35:6,8,10,14,16,18,19). English convention: Jehonadab. 'YHWH-impels'.
Long-form of Jonathan (Judg 18:30; 2Sam 21:21; 1Chr 27:25,32; 2Chr 17:8; Ezr 8:6; Neh 12:11,14,18,35; Jer 37:15,20; 38:26; 40:8). English convention: Jehonathan. 'YHWH-has-given'.
Variant of Joseph (Ps 81:5). English convention: Jehoseph.
Mother of Amaziah (2Kgs 14:2; 2Chr 25:1). English convention: Jehoaddan.
Father of Joshua the high priest (1Chr 6:14,15; Hag 1:1,12,14; 2:2,4; Zech 6:11). English convention: Jehozadak. 'YHWH-is-just'.

Two kings of same name in Israel and Judah (1Kgs 22:50; 2Kgs 1:17; 3:1,6; 8:16,21,23,24,25,29; 9:15,17,21,22,23,24; 11:2; 12:18; 1Chr 3:11; 2Chr 17:8; 21:1,3,5,9,16; 22:1,5,6,7,11). English convention: Jehoram. 'YHWH-is-exalted'.
Aunt of Joash who hid him (2Kgs 11:2). English convention: Jehosheba. 'YHWH-is-an-oath'.
Variant of Jehosheba (2Chr 22:11). English convention: Jehoshabeath.

Successor of Moses, also high-priest in Zechariah (Ex 17:9-14; 24:13; 32:17; 33:11; Num 11:28; 13:8,16; 14:6,30,38; 26:65; 27:18,22; 32:12,28; 34:17; Deut 1:38; 3:21,28; 31:3,7,14,23; 34:9; entire book of Joshua + 1Sam 6:14,18; 1Kgs 16:34; 2Kgs 23:8; 1Chr 7:27; Hag 1:1,12,14; 2:2,4; Zech 3:1-9; 6:11). English convention: Joshua. 'YHWH-saves'.

King of Judah and other persons (2Sam 8:16; 20:24; 1Kgs 4:17; 15:24; 22:2-50; 2Kgs 1:17; 3:1-14; 8:16; 9:2,14; 12:18; 1Chr 3:10; 11:43; 15:24; 18:15; 2Chr 17-22; Joel 3:2,12). English convention: Jehoshaphat. 'YHWH-judges'.
Judahite and Levite (1Chr 4:16; 2Chr 29:12). English convention: Jehaleleel. 'Praising-Mighty-One'.
Precious gem on high-priest's breastplate (Ex 28:18; 39:11; Eze 28:13). Hyphenated; KJV 'diamond' is unattested in Iron-Age Levant — concordant 'hard-stone' preserves the root-meaning of the gem.
Moabite town (Num 21:23; Deut 2:32; Josh 13:18; 21:36; Judg 11:20; 1Chr 6:78; Isa 15:4; Jer 48:21,34). English convention: Jahaz.
Multiple Levites and officials (2Kgs 18:18,26,37; 1Chr 6:21; 26:4; 2Chr 29:12; 34:8; Isa 36:3,11,22). English convention: Joah. 'YHWH-is-brother'.
Variant of Jehoahaz (2Chr 21:17; 25:23; 36:2; 36:4). English convention: Joahaz.

Prophet and many others (1Sam 8:2; 1Chr 4:35; 5:4,8,12; 6:33,36; 7:3; 11:38; 15:7,11,17; 23:8; 26:22; 27:20; 2Chr 29:12; Ezr 10:43; Neh 11:9; Joel 1:1). English convention: Joel. 'YHWH-is-Mighty-One'.
Son of Issachar (Gen 46:13). Hyphenated to distinguish from Job (H347). English convention: Job (in Issachar context).
Multiple persons including Edomite king (Gen 10:29; 36:33,34; Josh 11:1; 1Chr 1:23,44,45; 8:9,18). English convention: Jobab.

50th-year of release, also rams-horn announcing it (Ex 19:13; Lev 25:9-54; 27:17-24; Num 36:4; Josh 6:4-13). Standard concordant 'jubilee' (transliteration). The horn-and-year-of-release coalesce in single Hebrew lexeme.
Father of musicians (Gen 4:21). English convention: Jubal.
Multiple Levites and officials (1Chr 12:4,20; 2Chr 31:13; 35:9; Ezr 8:33; 10:22,23; Neh 8:7; 11:16). English convention: Jozabad.
Benjamite and David's hero (1Chr 8:16; 11:45). English convention: Joha.
Wall-builder and high-priest (Neh 3:6; 12:10,11,22; 13:28). English convention: Joiada.
Multiple priests (Ezr 8:16; Neh 11:5,10; 12:6,19). English convention: Joiarib.
Mother of Moses and Aaron (Ex 6:20; Num 26:59). English convention: Jochebed. 'YHWH-is-glory'.

Day, period-of-time, era — extremely frequent (~2,304 occ across the entire OT — Genesis 1's six 'days' of creation, the Sabbath-day, the day-of-YHWH, ten-thousand discrete contexts). Standard concordant 'day' covers literal-24-hour, indefinite period, judgment-time, etc; KJV always 'day'.
Son of Japheth, ancestor of the Greeks (Gen 10:2,4; 1Chr 1:5,7; Isa 66:19; Eze 27:13,19; Dan 8:21; 10:20; 11:2; Joel 3:6; Zech 9:13). English convention: Javan.
Father of Shelomith (Ezr 8:10). English convention: Josiphiah.
Son of Becher (1Chr 7:8) and David-officer (1Chr 27:28). Hyphenated.
Short form of Jehozadak (Ezr 3:2,8; 5:2; 10:18; Neh 12:26). Hyphenated.
Autumn-rain (Deut 11:14; Jer 5:24; Joel 2:23). Hyphenated to mark autumn-first-rain distinct from H4456 malqosh latter-rain.
Son of Zerubbabel (1Chr 3:20). Hyphenated. English convention: Jushab-hesed. 'Loyal-kindness-restored'.
David's mighty man (1Chr 11:43; 15:24). English convention: Joshaphat.

Gideon's youngest son and king of Judah (Judg 9:5,7,21,57; 2Kgs 15:5,7,30,32,38; 16:1; 1Chr 2:47; 3:12; 5:17; 2Chr 26:21,23; 27:1-9; Isa 1:1; 7:1; Hos 1:1; Mic 1:1). English convention: Jotham. 'YHWH-is-perfect'.
David's mighty man (1Chr 12:3). English convention: Jeziel.
Multiple persons (1Chr 7:3; Neh 12:42). English convention: Izrahiah. 'YHWH-shines'.
Inhabitant of Jezreel (1Sam 27:3; 30:5; 2Sam 2:2; 3:2; 1Kgs 21:1,4,6,7,15,16; 2Kgs 9:21,25; 1Chr 3:1). English convention: Jezreelite.
Female-inhabitant of Jezreel (1Sam 27:3; 30:5). English convention: Jezreelitess.
Levite and David's overseer-of-asses (1Chr 24:20; 27:30). English convention: Jehdeiah.
Multiple Levites and post-exilic figures (1Chr 12:4; 16:6; 23:19; 24:23; 2Chr 20:14; Ezr 8:5). English convention: Jahaziel. 'Mighty-One-sees'.
Prophet (Eze 1:3; 24:24; also priestly division 1Chr 24:16). English convention: Ezekiel. 'Mighty-One-strengthens'.
